title: Livestorm Review (2026)
intro: Livestorm is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Livestorm is a European-designed webinar and online events platform for marketing teams — registration pages, email cadences, browser-based live rooms, engagement tools, CRM integrations, analytics, and AI content repurposing, priced on attendee credits. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Livestorm when webinars and virtual events for marketing teams are the primary job — especially if you want browser-based rooms and pay-for-attendees pricing.
verdict: Choose Livestorm when webinars and virtual events for marketing teams are the primary job — especially if you want browser-based rooms and pay-for-attendees pricing. Compare Kartra when you need funnels/email/courses beyond events, Freshmarketer for marketing automation journeys, and SocialBee if social scheduling is the primary need. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Livestorm markets browser-based, no-download events with intuitive registration and room UX aimed at marketing teams — strong usability positioning.
Registration pages, branded rooms, and email cadences support webinar campaigns; not a general campaign/content calendar suite.
Email cadences and CRM sync help webinar workflows; deeper MA journeys live in connected tools — moderate by design.
Registration conversion, attendance rate, and webinar conversion analytics are first-party strengths for event-led funnels.
UTM capture, attendance, engagement, and conversion metrics are core post-event analytics — high for webinar attribution, not full multi-channel.
Not a social listening product — low score by design.
HubSpot native on Pro; Salesforce/Marketo/Pardot/Dynamics/Brevo on Enterprise plus API/webhooks — strong marketing-stack connectivity.
Up to 3,000 live attendees/event, unlimited team members, Enterprise duration/CS path — solid webinar scale.
Pay-for-actual-attendees (no-shows free; team free) is fair packaging; €2.50/credit and pack sizing still require volume planning — mid-strong excluding affiliate terms.
AI transcription, content repurposing, and AI Studio clips are marketed; live translations are add-ons — solid assistance, not unlimited AI.

faq.answer: No. Livestorm is evaluated as Marketing & Growth software. For core ESP/newsletter tools, see email-marketing category peers like GetResponse or AWeber.

• Not a social scheduling, listening, or full ESP platform
• Running out of attendee credits blocks new attendees until upgrade
